# human-synapse-bouton-lab

> Full-stack, formally verified human synaptic bouton biophysical workbench, Lean 4.35.0 proofs, stochastic Monte Carlo nanocolumn simulator, and 11-discipline open hard problems & consciousness frontier monograph. Built and verified to the Build Standard for LLMs v1.1.0.

Start with AGENTS.md for commands and rules. llms-full.txt contains everything in one file.

## Agent instructions

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical agent instructions, hard rules, finding classes, checklist
- [Build standard](docs/build-standard.md): all 90 items with why, how, examples, done-when checks and evidence

## Project docs

- [README](README.md): purpose, quickstart, usage, results, limitations
- [Claims ledger](CLAIMS.md): every claim mapped to its command and test
- [Replication](REPLICATION.md): how to reproduce the headline results

## Optional
